# Skip Backward

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Skips backwards in the current media queue.

## Syntax

~~~~text
skipBack(point: <#Enumeration (WFSkipBackBehavior)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
skipBack(point: Beginning)
~~~~
